name: Bill's Bussin' Buffet
source:
The theme was "together" so our game is about getting together with some bussin babes at a diner. Bring the right food together, to-get-her (or him). 

[From [url=https://itsnotagoodtime.itch.io/bills-bussin-buffet]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主题是“在一起”，所以我们的游戏是关于在餐馆里与一些生意宝贝聚在一起的。将合适的食物放在一起，吸引她（或他）。

[来自[url=https://itsnotagoodtime.itch.io/bills-bussin-buffet]Itch.io[/url]]
